minimum_change: Import existing AgentdMethod and DrainSnapshot types into this fixture only.
Keep original Health payload fields and source unchanged for AgentdMethod::Health.

Select AgentdPayload::Drain only when request.method is Drain and request.schema_version equals AGENTD_CONTROL_SCHEMA_VERSION, request.spawn_generation equals the child environment spawn generation, retained lifecycle belongs to the same agent, lifecycle is Draining and current generation is checked_add(spawn_generation, 2).

After those exact checks, acknowledge admission_closed=true, running_turns=0 and drained=true with that retained Draining lifecycle and fenced=false. This fixture never implements objective/run admission and has no running assistant tasks; it must not manufacture an acknowledgement from merely receiving a Drain method.
Reject unsupported requests or incorrect request/lifecycle fences explicitly; do not fall back to Health or rewrite durable lifecycle to force a match.
Reuse the existing AgentdResponse envelope with actual agent ID, child spawn generation and latest retained current generation, request ID and existing newline framing.
unchanged: production UnixProcessDriver and its strict Drain validation
same two/five pair counts and PID/generation/isolation assertions
original 60 second watchdog and per-operation test deadlines
release immutable-copy and full-content digest checks
evidence_needed_before_apply: Authoritative focused/native run with existing CI debug0 alignment should reach the original two-pair restart and show the predicted protocol error; keep its log/source/profile receipt separate from the earlier pre-start timeouts.
candidate_assertion_policy: Existing product assertions stay intact. Native owner runs original package strict/tests and default workspace gate; no success claim from this proposal.
